title: Twin-Column Band Saws — Value-Line Double Column Bandsaws | NovoTech
meta_description: Value-line twin-column band saws: TBK-4228 series, gear-driven TGK-4235 / 4240 and GZ4250/70 / 24 gantry saws for plate and bundles. Specs in inches and mm.
intro: Twin-column saws at value-line prices: the bow travels vertically on two columns, so the cut stays square in solid bar, blocks and bundles. The TBK-4228 series offers manual feed, a 45° miter (mitre) version and two automatics; the TGK-4235 and 4240 add gear drive and hydraulic blade tension; the GZ4250/70 and GZ4260/120 are gantry saws for plate up to 47-1/4″ wide. Known as double column, twin-column or dual column metal bandsaws, these horizontal band saw machines are the industrial choice for heavy solids, bundles and plate.
hero_points: Twin-column guidance for square cuts in heavy stock
Hydraulic down-feed and clamping on every model; automatic feed on the TBK-4228B / 4228B (improved)
Round capacities from Ø11″ (280 mm) to Ø23-5/8″ (600 mm)
hero_brand_line: NovoTech's own brand: manufactured in China to high North American quality standards, with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and Mississauga, ON parts and support as every machine we sell.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech double-column band saws

faq.q: Why choose a double-column saw over a pivot saw?
faq.a: Rigidity and capacity. The bow is guided on two columns, so there is no side load on the blade — cuts stay square in large solids and the blade lasts longer. The GZ4250/70 and GZ4260/120 gantry saws also take plate and bundles a pivot bow cannot.

faq.q: Which value-line double-column saws are automatic?
faq.a: The TBK-4228B and TBK-4228B (improved) feed and cut automatically with a shuttle vise; the AV adds stepless blade speed and a chip conveyor. The TBK-4228, TBK-4228A, TGK-4235, TGK-4240, GZ4250/70 and GZ4260/120 are hydraulic semi-automatics with manual material feed.

faq.q: Can a value-line double-column saw cut miters?
faq.a: The TBK-4228A swivels for cuts at 30° and 45° (Ø10-1/4″ and Ø6-3/4″). The other value-line double-column models are straight-cut saws.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
